description: CERC develops ADMS-Urban for urban air-dispersion assessment. It represents pollutant emissions from different source types and estimates concentrations with meteorology and local context. The provider describes metre-scale detail where appropriate, not a universal grid for every city. It supports comparison of development and air-quality scenarios; results require suitable emissions, weather and model configuration. Published by Cambridge Environmental Research Consultants (CERC). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: Commercial CERC licence. Software access is paid under the provider’s terms. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, optimisation. Related catalogue records: platform-qgis. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
